text.en: Atlas design study for this topic (docs/41-flower-and-seed-content-spec.md §2.6, §2.7, §3 and §9): a model specimen table, not a scan or a measurement of any specimen, and no brand. DESIGN: one round table 1.9 m across with five stations in the order of a flowering plant's life (flower, other pollinators, reproductive cells, fruits and seeds, the inside of a seed and a seed test) and a small side table for a bird's nest fern and a moss. Scales: chilli flower, flower cut in half and honeybee 20 times life size; bird's nest fern a quarter of life size, fronds about 80 cm long; green beans whole, split and sprouting 10 times life size; sunbird, cave nectar bat, durian flowers, fruits, cups and the seedling life size; moss, spore lines, fig and fig wasp drawn larger with no scale bar (no size found); pollen grains drawn very much larger, no scale (no size found); reproductive cells diagrams, not to scale. Air spaces in the cut sea almond drawn larger than life. Seed test: four clear plastic cups 7 cm across and 9 cm high, cotton wool, 5 green beans each; A damp cotton wool on a warm, bright windowsill; B dry cotton wool on the same windowsill; D damp cotton wool in a closed cupboard (door drawn open); E damp cotton wool in a small fridge (front drawn cut away); looked at on day 0 and day 7 only. Day strip 13 cm with 13 ticks (day 0 to day 12, 1 cm a day), a dish of 10 beans on a damp paper towel. Drawing: all procedural; the whole chilli flower, the green and the cut chilli, the angsana pod, the pollen grains and the split and sprouting green beans reuse the plant topic's own shapes, rescaled to these sizes; the flower cut in half, the bee, the coconut, the garden balsam pod and the young seedling are drawn new for this table. Furniture, schematic: a windowsill 40 cm wide, a cupboard 26 × 24 × 20 cm, a small fridge 30 × 36 × 28 cm; three durian flowers on a branch. MODEL RULES (the `seeds` model): a cup germinates by day 7 if it has water, air and warmth (windowsill and cupboard warm, fridge not warm); light is not in the rule; seedlings that germinate in the light are green, in the dark pale. Results: A germinated, green; B not germinated; D germinated, pale; E not germinated (an inference of this model). Fair comparisons: B against A (water), D against A (light), E against D (warmth); E against A changes two things. Timing: median germination time 4.3 days at 20 °C, 6.5 at 17 °C, 9.4 at 14 °C (S44); on day d the flag reads 'half or more of those that germinate' when d is at least the median. Dispersal: angsana wind (wing); sea almond and coconut water (air spaces, floats); chilli and fig animals (juicy fruit eaten); rubber tree and garden balsam bursting or splitting (dry fruit that bursts).
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/41-flower-and-seed-content-spec.md §2.6、§2.7、§3、§9）：一张模型标本台，不是任何标本的扫描或测量，也不涉及品牌。设计：一张直径 1.9 米的圆台，按开花植物一生的顺序摆五个工位（花、别的传粉者、生殖细胞、果实与种子、种子的里面与种子测试），旁边一张小台放巢蕨和苔藓。比例：辣椒花、剖开的花和蜜蜂放大 20 倍；巢蕨缩小到四分之一，叶长约 80 厘米；整粒、剖开和发芽的绿豆放大 10 倍；太阳鸟、洞穴花蜜蝠、榴莲花、果实、杯子和幼苗按实物大小；苔藓、孢子囊群、榕果和榕小蜂画得较大，没有比例尺（找不到尺寸）；花粉粒画得大很多，没有比例（找不到尺寸）；生殖细胞是示意图，不按比例。剖开的榄仁树果里的空隙画得比实物大。种子测试：四只直径 7 厘米、高 9 厘米的透明塑料杯，放棉花，每杯 5 粒绿豆；A 湿棉花，放在温暖明亮的窗台上；B 干棉花，同一个窗台；D 湿棉花，放在关着门的柜子里（柜门画成打开的）；E 湿棉花，放进小冰箱（前面画成剖开的）；只看第 0 天和第 7 天。天数卡长 13 厘米，13 道刻度（第 0 到第 12 天，每天 1 厘米）；一个培养皿，湿纸巾上放 10 粒绿豆。画法：全部程序化建模；整朵辣椒花、青辣椒与剖开的红辣椒、青龙木翅果、花粉粒，以及剖开的和发芽的绿豆，沿用“植物”主题的形状，按这里的尺寸缩放；剖开的花、蜜蜂、椰子、凤仙花果荚和幼苗为本台另画。家具是示意：窗台宽 40 厘米，柜子 26 × 24 × 20 厘米，小冰箱 30 × 36 × 28 厘米；枝上三朵榴莲花。模型规则（seeds 模型）：一杯到第 7 天发芽的条件是有水、有空气、温暖（窗台和柜子温暖，冰箱不温暖）；光不在规则里；在有光处发芽的幼苗是绿的，在暗处的发白。结果：A 发芽，绿色；B 没有发芽；D 发芽，发白；E 没有发芽（本模型的推断）。公平的比较：B 对 A（水）、D 对 A（光）、E 对 D（温度）；E 对 A 改了两样。天数：中位萌发时间 20 °C 4.3 天、17 °C 6.5 天、14 °C 9.4 天（S44）；第 d 天不少于中位数时，小旗读作“发芽的种子里有一半或更多”。传播：青龙木靠风（翅）；榄仁树果和椰子靠水（有空隙，能浮）；辣椒和榕果靠动物（动物吃的多汁果实）；橡胶树和凤仙花靠爆开或裂开（干了会爆开的果）。

note.en: Not a measurement. Sizes come from S6, S8, S9, S12, S15, S23, S26, S68, S69, S71 and S74; the cups, cotton wool, day strip, dish and table are design values with no source needed. The cup results combine S39 (water first), S40 and S42 (germination in the dark), S66 (pale in the dark) and S44 (temperature). Cup E is an inference: S44 estimates mung beans need about 9–10 °C to germinate and S67 puts a food chiller at 0–4 °C; no test of mung beans at fridge temperature was found. A cup under water (spec cup C) was left out: no source was found for what fully submerged mung beans do in a week. Real cups vary: S44 had about 94 % of seeds germinated by day 21 at 20 °C.
note.zh: 不是测量值。尺寸来自 S6、S8、S9、S12、S15、S23、S26、S68、S69、S71、S74；杯子、棉花、天数卡、培养皿和标本台是设计值，不需要来源。四杯的结果组合了 S39（先吸水）、S40 与 S42（暗处萌发）、S66（暗处发白）和 S44（温度）。E 杯是推断：S44 估计绿豆要约 9–10 °C 才能萌发，S67 说冷藏食物的冰箱在 0–4 °C；没有找到在冰箱温度下测试绿豆的研究。泡在水里的一杯（spec 的 C 杯）没有做：没有找到来源说明完全泡在水里的绿豆一星期里会怎样。真的杯子会有差别：S44 在 20 °C 下到第 21 天约 94 % 的种子发芽。

text.en: Ministry of Education, Singapore (CPDD), Science Teaching & Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, Standard / Foundation (cover: updated January 2026). Printed pp. 43–45, Cycles in Plants and Animals (Reproduction), P5 Standard: a cell is a basic unit of life; living things reproduce to ensure continuity of their kind and many characteristics are passed on from parents to offspring; pollination, fertilisation (seed production), seed dispersal and germination; fertilisation occurs when a male reproductive cell fuses with a female reproductive cell; fertilisation in humans (a sperm fuses with an egg; the fertilised egg develops in the womb; ovaries produce eggs and testes produce sperms); the similarity of fertilisation in flowering plants and humans; investigate the ways plants reproduce (spores, seeds). Pp. 46–47 (Foundation): fertilisation is the process that leads to the development of fruits and seeds. Pp. 15–16: recognise a fair test (P4), design a fair test (P6). P. 38: plants (flowering, non-flowering) and fungi. P. 69: structural adaptations help fruits and seeds in their dispersal.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部（课程规划与发展司）《小三至小六科学教学大纲（标准 / 基础）》（封面：2026 年 1 月更新）。印第 43–45 页“动植物的循环（繁殖）”小五标准：细胞是生命的基本单位；生物繁殖使同类延续，许多特征由亲代传给后代；传粉、受精（产生种子）、种子传播、萌发；受精是雄性生殖细胞与雌性生殖细胞融合；人的受精（精子与卵子融合；受精卵在子宫里发育；卵巢产生卵子，睾丸产生精子）；开花植物与人的受精的相似处；探究植物的繁殖方式（孢子、种子）。第 46–47 页（基础）：受精是让果实和种子形成的过程。第 15–16 页：认出公平测试（小四）、设计公平测试（小六）。第 38 页：植物（开花、不开花）与真菌。第 69 页：结构适应帮助果实和种子传播。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (local PDF, SHA-256 0556023c…3ab0; printed page n = PDF page n + 1). The notes on pp. 43–45 list what P5 does not require: two special terms for kinds of pollination, how the male cell reaches the female cell and where fertilisation happens, how a baby develops before birth, and growing new plants from parts of old ones. This topic follows those notes.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（本地 PDF，SHA-256 0556023c…3ab0；印第 n 页 = PDF 第 n + 1 页）。第 43–45 页的说明列出小五不要求的内容：描述传粉方式的两个专门名词、雄性生殖细胞怎样到达雌性生殖细胞以及受精在哪里发生、宝宝出生前怎样长大，以及用植物的一部分繁殖新植株。本主题照这些说明处理。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Eonycteris spelaea (Cave Nectar Bat).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：洞穴花蜜蝠（Cave Nectar Bat，Eonycteris spelaea）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Feed on nectar and pollen.' 'Important pollinator of many forest trees including durians.' 'Roosts in large colonies in caves, old buildings and under concrete bridges.' Conservation status 'Uncommon'; Singapore Red Data Book status 'Vulnerable (V) [1994]'; the page also says it is found in several locations 'but rare'. No Chinese name printed; 洞穴花蜜蝠 is an editorial translation of the English name. No body size on the page (see S68).
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。原文：吃花蜜和花粉；是包括榴莲在内许多森林树木的重要传粉者；成群栖息在山洞、旧建筑和混凝土桥下。保育状态“不常见”；《新加坡红皮书》状态“易危（1994）”；页面也说它见于几个地点“但稀少”。页面没有中文名；“洞穴花蜜蝠”是编辑按英文名直译的。页面没有体长（见 S68）。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Durio zibethinus (Durian, 榴莲).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：榴莲（Durio zibethinus）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The flowers 'bloom at night, releasing a strong odour to attract bats which are the main pollinators'. Flowers: 'Each flower has three petals, 5 - 7cm wide, with a bell-shaped calyx' — only the 5–7 cm width is used here; the petal count is not repeated.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。花在夜里开，散发浓烈的气味，蝙蝠是主要的传粉者。花：页面写“每朵花有三片花瓣，宽 5–7 厘米”，这里只用 5–7 厘米这个宽度，不重复花瓣数。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Pterocarpus indicus (Angsana, 青龙木).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：青龙木（Angsana，Pterocarpus indicus）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Fruit pod is disc-like (3 – 5 cm diameter)', with 'a flattened wing surrounding the central part'; 'dispersed by the wind'; flowers 'often only last for a day'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。荚果呈圆盘状（直径 3–5 厘米），中间四周是一圈扁平的翅；靠风传播；花常常只开一天。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Heritage Trees: Sea Almond (HT 2017-290).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局古树名录：榄仁树（HT 2017-290）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The fruits 'have a corky rind, which contains tiny air cavities that enable them to float, allowing dispersal by currents and waves to new shores for germination.' 'The fruits are also eaten by fruit bats and monkeys, which aid in seed dispersal.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实外层像软木，有细小的空隙，能浮在水上，随海流和海浪漂到新的岸边萌发；果蝠和猴子也吃这种果实，帮助传播种子。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Terminalia catappa (Sea Almond, 榄仁树).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：榄仁树（Sea Almond，Terminalia catappa）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Fruit 'flattened-egg-shaped, 3.5–7 wide long by 2–5.5 cm wide', with one seed. The page's wording has a typo ('wide long', no unit on the first number); read here as 3.5–7 cm long. 'The fruits are attractive to bats which also help with seed dispersal.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实呈压扁的卵形，一粒种子。页面原文有笔误（“3.5–7 wide long”，第一个数没有单位），这里读作长 3.5–7 厘米、宽 2–5.5 厘米。页面还说蝙蝠喜欢吃这种果实，也帮助传播种子。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Hevea brasiliensis (Para Rubber).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：橡胶树（Para Rubber，Hevea brasiliensis）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Fruit is a woody capsule with 3-lobed, and about 5 cm diameter.' 'When it dries, it explodes with a loud sound resembling the sound of a gun-shot', firing the three seeds away; dispersal 'Abiotic (Explosive Dehiscence)'. 'Seed is about 2.5 cm wide and has a beautiful marbled appearance.' No Chinese name printed; 橡胶树 is the usual name, an editorial choice.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实是三瓣的木质蒴果，直径约 5 厘米；干了以后爆开，声音像枪响，把三粒种子弹出去；传播方式“非生物（爆裂开裂）”。种子宽约 2.5 厘米，有大理石般的花纹。页面没有中文名；“橡胶树”是常用名，编辑用词。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Heritage Trees: Para Rubber (HT 2018-294).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局古树名录：橡胶树（HT 2018-294）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'The fruit is a hard pod with three compartments that explode loudly when ripe and dry, dispersing the seeds more than 20 m from the parent tree.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实是有三个室的硬荚，成熟变干时大声爆开，把种子撒到离母树 20 米以外。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Impatiens balsamina (Garden Balsam, 凤仙花).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：凤仙花（Garden Balsam，Impatiens balsamina）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Fruits 'split open easily to scatter small seeds'; the genus name refers to 'the explosive release of seeds from the fruit pod'; pollination 'Insects (Bee)'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实很容易裂开，撒出小种子；属名指种子从果荚里爆裂释放；传粉“昆虫（蜜蜂）”。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Cocos nucifera (Coconut, 椰子).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：椰子（Cocos nucifera）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The fruit has 'a fibrous husk (mesocarp)' and a hard, woody shell; fruits 'ovoid, up to 30 cm long'; the seed 'has a narrow, white layer of edible endosperm (flesh) and a large cavity filled with water'. The page does not mention floating; see S13.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。果实有纤维质的外皮（中果皮）和坚硬的木质壳；果实卵形，长可达 30 厘米；种子有一层窄窄的白色可食果肉和一个装满水的大腔。页面没有提到漂浮；见 S13。

text.en: Harries, H. C. & Clement, C. R. (2014). Long-distance dispersal of the coconut palm by migration within the coral atoll ecosystem. Annals of Botany 113(4): 565–570. doi:10.1093/aob/mct293.
text.zh: Harries, H. C. 与 Clement, C. R.（2014）《椰子在珊瑚环礁生态系统中迁移的远距离传播》，《植物学年鉴》113(4)：565–570，doi:10.1093/aob/mct293。

note.en: Abstract read 2026-10-21 via Europe PMC (the publisher's page refused automatic access). 'The cavity within the nut augments the buoyancy provided by the thick husk'. The sentence sits under the abstract's 'Hypothesis' heading: it is the authors' proposal, not a flotation measurement, and the text says so.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 通过 Europe PMC 读到摘要（出版社页面拒绝自动访问）。原文：果核里的腔增加了厚纤维外皮提供的浮力。这句话在摘要的“假说”标题下，是作者的提法，不是漂浮测量，正文照此写明。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Adenanthera pavonina (Saga, 相思豆).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：相思豆（Saga，Adenanthera pavonina）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The pod 'twists spirally and splits open to reveal the seeds within'; 'Seeds are eaten and dispersed by birds.' Used only as an example of a fruit with more than one way of dispersal.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。豆荚螺旋扭转裂开，露出里面的种子；种子被鸟吃掉并传播。只用作“不止一种传播方式”的例子。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Ficus variegata (Common Red-stem Fig, 青果榕).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：青果榕（Common Red-stem Fig，Ficus variegata）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'The flowers are tiny and develop within the syconium (fig).' 'Its flowers are pollinated by the fig wasp (Ceratosolen appendiculatus), and its ripe syconia are eaten by birds.' 'Ripe figs are food for plantain squirrels and long-tailed macaques.' Figs 'pear-shaped, green with rose-red streaks when ripe, up to 5 cm wide'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。花很小，长在隐头花序（榕果）里面；花由榕小蜂 Ceratosolen appendiculatus 传粉，成熟的榕果被鸟吃；成熟的榕果是蕉松鼠和长尾猕猴的食物；榕果梨形，成熟时绿色带玫红色条纹，宽可达 5 厘米。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, 'Seed dispersal for plant reproduction' (Primary 5 learning resources).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局《种子传播与植物繁殖》（小五学习资源）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Native examples: Marsh Pulai and Keruing (wind); Sea Pong Pong and Katong Laut (water); Ohwia caudata and Bur Mallow (animals); 'Some plants can disperse their own seeds through explosive action or splitting', with Champaca and Twin-seed. Bur mallow's Chinese name 地桃花 is from NParks's Flora & Fauna Web.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。本地例子：Marsh Pulai、Keruing（风）；Sea Pong Pong、Katong Laut（水）；Ohwia caudata、Bur Mallow（动物）；有些植物靠爆开或裂开自己传播种子，例如 Champaca、Twin-seed。Bur Mallow 的中文名“地桃花”取自 NParks 的 Flora & Fauna Web。

text.en: Ng Wenli, 'The Wings Behind Flowers', National Parks Board Singapore, 4 February 2025.
text.zh: Ng Wenli《花朵背后的翅膀》，新加坡国家公园局，2025 年 2 月 4 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Bees are 'the main pollinator for many food crops today'; 'sunbirds also have thin, downward-curving beaks'; 'Only fig wasps can pollinate the fig trees'; fig trees 'have flowers hidden inside the fig'; 'The female fig wasps reproduce by entering a fig and laying its eggs in it.' The last two sentences were read through the fetch tool's extraction and not string-checked against a saved page; the species page S15 confirms the flowers are inside the fig.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。蜜蜂是今天许多粮食作物的主要传粉者；太阳鸟的喙细长、向下弯；只有榕小蜂能给榕树传粉；榕树的花藏在榕果里；雌榕小蜂钻进榕果产卵繁殖。最后两句只读到抓取工具的提取文本，没有和保存的网页逐字核对；物种页 S15 证实花长在榕果里。

text.en: Tok Yin Xin, 'Identifying the Sunbirds of Singapore', National Parks Board Singapore, 11 February 2025.
text.zh: Tok Yin Xin《认识新加坡的太阳鸟》，新加坡国家公园局，2025 年 2 月 11 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'There are seven species of sunbirds in Singapore', the commonest being the Olive-backed Sunbird (Cinnyris jugularis) and the Brown-throated Sunbird; 'Due to their feeding patterns, they also act as pollinators to the flowers that they visit.' Female olive-backed sunbird: olive-green upper parts, yellow under parts; male: iridescent blue forehead, throat and upper breast. See S20 for the other name.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。新加坡有七种太阳鸟，最常见的是 Olive-backed Sunbird（Cinnyris jugularis）和 Brown-throated Sunbird；因为它们的取食方式，它们也给所访的花传粉。Olive-backed Sunbird 雌鸟上身橄榄绿、下身黄色；雄鸟的额、喉和上胸有闪亮的蓝色。另一个名字见 S20。

text.en: Wee, Y. C. (2018). Olive-backed Sunbird: sipping nectar from flowers of Scarlet Spiral Flag. Bird Ecology Study Group, 31 July 2018.
text.zh: Wee, Y. C.（2018）《Olive-backed Sunbird 在 Scarlet Spiral Flag 的花上吸食花蜜》，鸟类生态研究小组，2018 年 7 月 31 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. A sunbird feeding from the front of the flower, its beak 'dusted with pollen will transfer some to the stigma of the next flower'; it may also 'pierce through the base of the flower petals to short-cut the process'. An observation note, not a study.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。太阳鸟从花口取食时，沾了花粉的喙会把一部分花粉带到下一朵花的柱头上；它有时也会啄穿花瓣基部抄近路。这是观察记录，不是研究。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Cinnyris ornatus (Ornate Sunbird).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：Ornate Sunbird（Cinnyris ornatus）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The page gives the common name Ornate Sunbird (its HTML title still reads Olive-backed Sunbird) and describes females with 'upperparts dull olive brown; underparts all yellow'. It does not mention pollination. The topic's main text says only 'sunbird'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。页面的通用名是 Ornate Sunbird（网页标题仍写 Olive-backed Sunbird），说雌鸟上身暗橄榄褐色、下身全黄。页面没有提到传粉。本主题正文只说“太阳鸟”。

text.en: Chan, K. W. (2013). Cave fruit bat and mourning gecko on golden penda tree. Singapore Biodiversity Records 2013: 108–109. Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum, National University of Singapore.
text.zh: Chan, K. W.（2013）《金蒲桃上的洞穴果蝠与哀鸣壁虎》，《新加坡生物多样性记录》2013：108–109，新加坡国立大学李光前自然历史博物馆。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. A cave nectar bat photographed on the night of 5 April 2012 at a golden penda tree; 'its flight membranes appear to be covered with yellow pollen'. An observation record, not a pollination study.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。2012 年 4 月 5 日晚上，在一棵金蒲桃上拍到一只洞穴花蜜蝠，它的翼膜上似乎沾满了黄色的花粉。这是观察记录，不是传粉研究。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, 'Every Child a Seed' (Primary 3 programme).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局“每个孩子一粒种子”（小三活动）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Young plants are kept in a 'warm and semi-shaded environment', with the soil moist but not waterlogged.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。幼苗放在温暖、半荫的环境里，土壤湿润而不积水。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Asplenium nidus var. nidus (Bird's Nest Fern, 巢蕨).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：巢蕨（Bird's Nest Fern，Asplenium nidus var. nidus）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Epiphytic fern'; 'leaf length can be up to 150 cm or more and up to 20 cm wide'; 'The sori are narrow, and occur on every vein of the top half of the frond'; 'Spores are light brown, transparent when fresh and opaque when old.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。附生蕨；叶长可达 150 厘米或更长，宽可达 20 厘米；孢子囊群窄，长在叶片上半部的每一条叶脉上；孢子浅褐色，新鲜时透明，老了不透明。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, 'Is it a Fern? Double Con-fern!', 3 February 2025.
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局《这是蕨吗？》，2025 年 2 月 3 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Ferns 'do not flower and instead reproduce via spores on the undersides of their leaves'; 'The Birds’ Nest Fern (Asplenium nidus) is a large epiphytic fern that is commonly seen on many trees in Singapore.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。蕨类植物不开花，靠叶背上的孢子繁殖；巢蕨是一种大型附生蕨，在新加坡的许多树上都能见到。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Capsicum annuum (Chilli, 辣椒).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：辣椒（Chilli，Capsicum annuum）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'White, 1 cm-wide flowers have purple anthers (the pollen-bearing tip of the male part)'; pollination 'Insects (Bee)'; seed quantity 'Numerous (>20)'; 'The chillis grow up to 15 cm long'; fruit colours green, orange, purple, red and yellow.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。花白色，宽 1 厘米，花药紫色；传粉“昆虫（蜜蜂）”；种子数“很多（20 粒以上）”；辣椒长可达 15 厘米；果实有绿、橙、紫、红、黄几种颜色。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, Flora & Fauna Web: Vigna radiata (Mung bean, 绿豆).
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 Flora & Fauna Web：绿豆（Mung bean，Vigna radiata）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Common names Mung bean, Green gram, Green bean; Chinese name 绿豆. The page gives pod size but no seed size (see S71).
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。英文名 Mung bean、Green gram、Green bean；中文名绿豆。页面有豆荚的大小，没有种子的大小（见 S71）。

text.en: National Environment Agency, Singapore, '2018 Is Singapore's Eighth Warmest Year On Record', news release, 15 January 2019.
text.zh: 新加坡国家环境局新闻稿《2018 年是新加坡有记录以来第八暖的一年》，2019 年 1 月 15 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'the last decade from 2009 to 2018 marks the warmest decade on record in Singapore with mean temperature of 27.89°C'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。2009 到 2018 年是新加坡有记录以来最暖的十年，平均气温 27.89 °C。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 32.1 Reproductive Development and Structure.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 32.1 节“繁殖的发育与结构”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'The androecium has stamens with anthers that contain the microsporangia.' 'The carpel is the individual unit of the gynoecium and has a stigma, style, and ovary.' 'The ovary, which may contain one or multiple ovules'. OpenStax says carpel; this topic says pistil, as the plant topic does.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。雄蕊群由雄蕊组成，花药里有小孢子囊；心皮是雌蕊群的单位，有柱头、花柱和子房；子房里可以有一个或多个胚珠。OpenStax 用“心皮”，本主题和“一株植物”一样用“雌蕊”。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 32.2 Pollination and Fertilization.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 32.2 节“传粉与受精”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Pollination is the transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma, and pollen brings the sperm cells to the ovule; 'The fertilized ovule forms the seed, whereas the tissues of the ovary become the fruit, usually enveloping the seed.' Insects pick up pollen on body hairs; 'Brightly colored, odorless flowers that are open during the day are pollinated by birds.' 'As the bats seek the nectar, their faces and heads become covered with pollen, which is then transferred to the next flower.' 'many angiosperms, such as grasses, maples and oaks, are pollinated by wind.' In beans and other dicots without endosperm, the food is stored in the seed leaves (cotyledons). This topic does not use the section's detail on how the cells meet (not in the P5 syllabus).
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。传粉是花粉从花药到柱头，花粉把精细胞带到胚珠；受精的胚珠形成种子，子房的组织变成果实，通常把种子包在里面。昆虫用身上的毛沾带花粉；颜色鲜艳、没有气味、白天开的花由鸟传粉；蝙蝠吃花蜜时脸和头上沾满花粉，再带到下一朵花；草、枫、橡等许多被子植物靠风传粉。豆类等没有胚乳的双子叶植物，养分储存在子叶里。本主题不用这一节讲两个细胞怎样相遇的内容（不在小五课纲里）。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 25.4 Seedless Vascular Plants.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 25.4 节“无种子维管植物”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'On the underside of each mature fern frond are groups of sporangia called sori'; spores 'are released into the air from the sporangium'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。成熟的蕨叶背面有一群群孢子囊，叫孢子囊群；孢子从孢子囊放到空气中。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 25.3 Bryophytes.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 25.3 节“苔藓植物”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'The peristome opens and closes, depending on moisture levels, and periodically releases spores.' 'More than 25,000 species of bryophytes thrive in mostly damp habitats, although some live in deserts.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。蒴齿随湿度张开、合上，不时放出孢子；苔藓植物有 25,000 多种，大多生活在潮湿的地方，也有的生活在沙漠里。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 24.1 Characteristics of Fungi.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 24.1 节“真菌的特征”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Fungal spores are smaller and lighter than plant seeds'; they spread by 'floating on the wind or hitching a ride on an animal'. Used in the chapter 01 More box only.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。真菌的孢子比植物的种子小而轻，随风飘或附在动物身上传播。只用在第 01 章的细看里。

text.en: OpenStax, Biology 2e, section 26.1 Evolution of Seed Plants.
text.zh: OpenStax《Biology 2e》第 26.1 节“种子植物的演化”。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Seeds offer the embryo protection, nourishment, and a mechanism to maintain dormancy'; 'Storage tissue to sustain growth of the embryo and a protective coat give seeds their superior evolutionary advantage.' 'Bryophyte and fern spores are haploid cells'. No sentence was found saying a spore has no stored food, so the topic does not say it.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。种子给胚提供保护、养分和维持休眠的机制；储存组织和保护性的种皮使种子有优势；苔藓和蕨的孢子是单倍体细胞。没有找到“孢子没有储存的养分”这句话，所以本主题不这样说。

text.en: Aziz, S. A. et al. (2017). Pollination by the locally endangered island flying fox (Pteropus hypomelanus) enhances fruit production of the economically important durian (Durio zibethinus). Ecology and Evolution 7(21): 8670–8684.
text.zh: Aziz, S. A. 等（2017）《当地濒危的岛狐蝠传粉提高了重要经济作物榴莲的产量》，《生态与演化》7(21)：8670–8684。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (full text). A field study on Tioman Island, Malaysia: 'Flying foxes had a positive effect on mature fruit set and therefore serve as important pollinators for durian trees.' Cave nectar bats were also recorded visiting the durian trees. Not a Singapore study, and mainly about a different bat.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（全文）。马来西亚刁曼岛的野外研究：狐蝠提高了成熟果实的结实率，是榴莲的重要传粉者。研究也记录到洞穴花蜜蝠访问这些榴莲树。不是新加坡的研究，主要讲的是另一种蝙蝠。

text.en: Tewksbury, J. J. & Nabhan, G. P. (2001). Directed deterrence by capsaicin in chillies. Nature 412: 403–404. doi:10.1038/35086653.
text.zh: Tewksbury, J. J. 与 Nabhan, G. P.（2001）《辣椒中辣椒素的定向威慑》，《自然》412：403–404，doi:10.1038/35086653。

note.en: Abstract read 2026-10-21 (PubMed). Capsaicin 'selectively discourages vertebrate predators without deterring more effective seed dispersers'. Wild chillies in North America, eaten by a bird.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读到摘要（PubMed）。辣椒素有选择地挡住吃种子的脊椎动物，却不挡更有效的种子传播者。研究对象是北美的野生辣椒和吃它的鸟。

text.en: ScienceDaily, 'For Peppers, “Hot” Quite Literally The Spice Of Life', 26 July 2001 (news release on S37).
text.zh: ScienceDaily《对辣椒来说，“辣”真的是生存之道》，2001 年 7 月 26 日（S37 的新闻稿）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'the birds passed the seeds whole and capable of germinating'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。鸟排出的种子是完整的，还能萌发。

text.en: Relf, D. & Ball, E. Plant Propagation from Seed. Virginia Cooperative Extension publication 426-001.
text.zh: Relf, D. 与 Ball, E.《用种子繁殖植物》，弗吉尼亚合作推广服务出版物 426-001。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. A seed has 'the outer seed coat, which protects the seed; a food reserve (e.g., the endosperm); and the embryo'. 'There are four environmental factors which affect germination: water, oxygen, light, and temperature.' 'The first step in the germination process is the imbibition or absorption of water.' 'If the oxygen supply during germination is limited or reduced, germination can be severely retarded or inhibited.' 'Respiration takes place in all viable seed.' 'Light is known to stimulate or to inhibit germination of some seed.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。种子有保护种子的外种皮、储存的养分（如胚乳）和胚；影响萌发的环境因素有四个：水、氧、光和温度；萌发的第一步是吸水；萌发时氧气供应受限或减少，萌发会大大推迟或受到抑制；所有活的种子都在呼吸；已知光会促进或抑制某些种子的萌发。

text.en: BBSRC (UK Research and Innovation), Easy-PEAsy seed germination: teachers' pack and student sheets.
text.zh: 英国生物技术与生物科学研究理事会（UKRI）《Easy-PEAsy 种子萌发》教师手册与学生活动单。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (PDF). 'The food store provides the energy required to form a root and a stem, even in the absence of light.' 'The pea seed however will germinate in either light or dark conditions as long as there is adequate warmth and water.' 'Some seeds require exposure to either light or to dark conditions to ‘trigger’ germination.' Four groups of peas, light or dark and cool or warm, with the cool pair and the warm pair kept together 'to ensure that the test is fair'; seedlings measured 'After five to seven days'; peas in the warm dark 'will display signs of light deficiency'. Peas, not mung beans.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（PDF）。种子储存的养分在没有光时也能提供长出根和茎所需的能量；只要够暖、有足够的水，豌豆在亮处和暗处都会萌发；有些种子要光或要暗才“启动”萌发。豌豆分四组：亮或暗、凉或暖，两个凉组放一起、两个暖组放一起，以保证测试公平；五到七天后量幼苗；在温暖暗处的豌豆会出现缺光的迹象。研究对象是豌豆，不是绿豆。

text.en: Gardens by the Bay, 'Speedy Sprouts' (learning resource).
text.zh: 滨海湾花园《快快发芽》（学习资源）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Mung bean sprouts can be grown in just 3-4 days.' 'Soak the mung beans for 12 hours or overnight'; 'Set it in a dark place near your kitchen sink, such as a cupboard.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。绿豆芽只要 3–4 天就能长成；先把绿豆泡 12 小时或一整夜；放在厨房水槽附近的暗处，比如柜子里。

text.en: Bass, L. & Sanders, D. Bean Sprouts and Other Vegetable Seed Sprouts. NC State Extension, Horticulture Information Leaflet (1994).
text.zh: Bass, L. 与 Sanders, D.《豆芽和其他蔬菜种子的芽菜》，美国北卡罗来纳州立大学推广服务园艺资料单（1994）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Sprouting is best done at 70 to 80°F in a dark place.' (about 21–27 °C) 'It will take 3 to 7 days to obtain mature sized sprouts, depending on the temperature.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。芽菜最好在 70–80 °F（约 21–27 °C）的暗处培育；按温度不同，3 到 7 天长成。

text.en: Silwal, S. et al. (2026). Critical temperature requirement for the germination and establishment of mungbean (Vigna radiata L.) in temperate environments. Frontiers in Plant Science.
text.zh: Silwal, S. 等（2026）《温带环境中绿豆萌发与成苗的临界温度要求》，《植物科学前沿》。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (full text). Laboratory study (Agriculture Victoria, Horsham, Australia): 32 mung bean genotypes, 10 seeds per genotype on damp paper towels, at constant 14, 17 and 20 °C 'with a 10-h photoperiod'; a seed counted as germinated at a radicle of at least 3 mm. 'The median time to germinate mungbean seeds was 4.3 days at 20°C, 6.5 days at 17°C and 9.4 days for 14°C.' The median (GT50) is 'the time to reach 50% of maximum germination': half of the seeds that finally germinated, not half of all seeds. Table 3 (means over genotypes): by day 7, 86 % germinated at 20 °C and 12 % at 14 °C; by day 21, 94 % at 20 °C and 61 % at 14 °C (the body text says 85 % and 60 %). Base temperatures 8.6 and 9.8 °C for two cultivars; the cited literature gives 10 °C.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（全文）。实验室研究（澳大利亚维多利亚州农业局，霍舍姆）：32 个绿豆品种，每个品种 10 粒放在湿纸巾上，恒温 14、17、20 °C，每天光照 10 小时；胚根长到 3 毫米以上算发芽。中位萌发时间 20 °C 4.3 天、17 °C 6.5 天、14 °C 9.4 天。中位数（GT50）是“达到最大发芽率的 50 %”的时间，即最终发芽的种子的一半，而不是全部种子的一半。表 3（各品种的平均）：第 7 天 20 °C 发芽 86 %、14 °C 12 %；第 21 天 20 °C 94 %、14 °C 61 %（正文写 85 % 和 60 %）。两个品种的基础温度为 8.6 和 9.8 °C；文中引用的文献给 10 °C。

text.en: Oplinger, E. S. et al. (1990). Mungbean. Alternative Field Crops Manual. Purdue University NewCROP.
text.zh: Oplinger, E. S. 等（1990）《绿豆》，《替代大田作物手册》，普渡大学 NewCROP。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'Germination is epigeal with the cotyledons and stem emerging from the seedbed.'
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。绿豆的萌发是子叶出土型：子叶和茎一起钻出苗床。

text.en: Science Foundation Ireland, Discover Primary Science, 'Investigating Falling Things: Paper Helicopters'.
text.zh: 爱尔兰科学基金会 Discover Primary Science《落体探究：纸螺旋桨》。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (PDF). A fair test by 'changing only one variable at a time and keeping everything else constant such as the height of the drop'; real seeds: 'Possibly too many variables in nature'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（PDF）。公平测试一次只改变一个变量，其他保持不变，比如落下的高度；真的种子“大自然里变量可能太多”。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 传粉 (pollination).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：传粉。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. '傳粉又稱授粉' (pollination is also called 授粉); a footnote warns that 授 is easily confused with the 受 of 受精 (fertilisation). Used for the Chinese terms only.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。“传粉又称授粉”；脚注提醒“授”容易和“受精”的“受”混淆。只用于中文用词。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 花 (flower).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：花。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Flower-part terms: 花瓣, 萼片, 雄蕊, 花药, 花丝, 雌蕊, 柱头, 花柱, 子房, 胚珠, 花粉. Used for the Chinese terms only.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。花的各部分名称：花瓣、萼片、雄蕊、花药、花丝、雌蕊、柱头、花柱、子房、胚珠、花粉。只用于中文用词。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 孢子 (spore).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：孢子。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Terms 孢子, 孢子囊, 蕨類植物 (traditional characters) and 真菌. The article covers spores in general, fungi included, and says a spore may be one cell or several; the topic's 'usually a single cell' is for plant spores (S65). Used for the Chinese terms.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。用词：孢子、孢子囊、蕨类植物（原文繁体）、真菌。条目讲的是一般的孢子（包括真菌），说孢子可以是一个或几个细胞；本主题说植物的孢子“通常是一个细胞”，依据 S65。用于中文用词。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 种子传播 (seed dispersal).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：种子传播。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. The article title 种子传播 and its kinds: 風力傳播, 水力傳播, 動物傳播, 自身傳播 (traditional characters). Used for the Chinese terms only.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。条目名“种子传播”，类别有风力传播、水力传播、动物传播、自身传播（原文繁体）。只用于中文用词。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 发芽 (germination).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：发芽。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 種子萌發 and 萌芽 redirect to 發芽. This topic uses 萌发, as the plant topic does, and 发芽 in everyday sentences.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。“种子萌发”“萌芽”都重定向到“发芽”。本主题和“一株植物”一样用“萌发”，日常句子里用“发芽”。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 太阳鸟科 (sunbirds).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：太阳鸟科。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Main name 太阳鸟科, also called 花蜜鸟科. NParks prints no Chinese names for Singapore's sunbirds, so the topic uses 太阳鸟 and keeps the species' English names.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。条目名“太阳鸟科”，也叫“花蜜鸟科”。NParks 没有印新加坡太阳鸟的中文名，所以本主题用“太阳鸟”，具体种名保留英文。

text.en: Education Bureau, Hong Kong, An English-Chinese Glossary of Terms Commonly Used in the Teaching of Science (S1–3), 2017.
text.zh: 香港教育局《科学科常用英汉词汇（中一至中三）》，2017 年。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'germinate' 萌芽，發芽，萌發; 'seed plant' 有種子植物，種子植物. A Hong Kong secondary glossary in traditional characters: no Singapore primary Chinese science glossary was found.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。germinate：萌芽、发芽、萌发；seed plant：种子植物。这是香港的中学词表（繁体）：没有找到新加坡小学的中文科学词表。

text.en: Flora of China, Vol. 17 (Solanaceae): Capsicum and Capsicum annuum L. 辣椒. eFloras.org.
text.zh: 《中国植物志》英文版（Flora of China）第 17 卷茄科：辣椒属与辣椒（Capsicum annuum L.），eFloras.org。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (as for the plant topic). 'Pedicel bent at apex'; 'Corolla white, ca. 1 cm'; 'Anthers purplish'; seeds 'pale yellow, discoid or reniform, 3-5 mm'; genus: 'Ovary 2- (or 3)- locular'. Petal and stamen counts are not given (see S64).
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（同“一株植物”）。花梗顶端弯曲；花冠白色，约 1 厘米；花药带紫色；种子浅黄色，圆盘形或肾形，3–5 毫米；属：子房 2（或 3）室。没有给花瓣和雄蕊的数目（见 S64）。

text.en: Cruz, D. de O. et al. (2005). Pollination efficiency of the stingless bee Melipona subnitida on greenhouse sweet pepper. Pesquisa Agropecuária Brasileira 40(12). doi:10.1590/S0100-204X2005001200006.
text.zh: Cruz 等（2005）《无刺蜂 Melipona subnitida 对温室甜椒的传粉效率》，《巴西农业研究》40(12)，doi:10.1590/S0100-204X2005001200006。

note.en: Abstract read (as for the plant topic). Sweet pepper flowers are 'considered autogamous', yet bee pollination gave 'fruits significantly heavier and wider', 'containing a greater number of seeds'. Sweet pepper in a greenhouse, not chilli in the open.
note.zh: 读到摘要（同“一株植物”）。甜椒花被认为能自花授粉，但蜜蜂传粉结出的果实明显更重、更宽，种子更多。研究对象是温室里的甜椒，不是露天的辣椒。

text.en: National Parks Board Singapore, GardeningSG Resource Library: 'Chilli'.
text.zh: 新加坡国家公园局 GardeningSG 资源库：“辣椒”。

note.en: Read (as for the plant topic): 'this plant is buzz-pollinated and produces the most fruit when bees are around'.
note.zh: 读取（同“一株植物”）：辣椒靠振动传粉，有蜜蜂的时候结果最多。

text.en: Flora of North America, Vol. 14: Capsicum Linnaeus (W. Hardy Eshbaugh). eFloras.org.
text.zh: 《北美植物志》第 14 卷：辣椒属（W. Hardy Eshbaugh），eFloras.org。

note.en: Read (as for the plant topic, its S11). 'Flowers 5–7-merous': parts in fives to sevens. The model draws 5 petals and 5 stamens, a design choice shared with the plant topic.
note.zh: 读取（同“一株植物”的 S11）。花五至七基数：各部分五到七个一组。模型画 5 片花瓣、5 枚雄蕊，是和“一株植物”相同的设计选择。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Spore.
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Spore（孢子）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'In plants, spores are usually haploid and unicellular'; 'spores are unicellular, the first cell of a gametophyte, while seeds contain within them a developing embryo'. A tertiary source, used for 'usually a single cell, with no tiny plant inside'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。植物的孢子通常是单倍体、单细胞的；孢子是单细胞，而种子里面有一个正在发育的胚。这是三手资料，用于“通常只是一个细胞，里面没有小小的胚”。

text.en: Mastropasqua, L. et al. (2020). Effects of Darkness and Light Spectra on Nutrients and Pigments in Radish, Soybean, Mung Bean and Pumpkin Sprouts..
text.zh: Mastropasqua, L. 等（2020）《黑暗与不同光谱对萝卜、大豆、绿豆和南瓜芽菜营养成分与色素的影响》。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (full text). Sprouts germinated for 5 days at 24 °C under different light or 'in continuous darkness'; 'The lowest level of chlorophylls and carotenoids was observed in darkness for various sprouts, with the minimal value in mung beans.' The basis for the pale seedlings in cup D.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（全文）。芽菜在 24 °C 下、不同的光或持续黑暗中萌发 5 天；各种芽菜在黑暗中叶绿素和类胡萝卜素最少，绿豆芽最少。D 杯幼苗发白的依据。

text.en: Singapore Food Agency, Advisory: adopting good food safety and personal hygiene practices (circular to food business operators), 6 December 2024.
text.zh: 新加坡食品局《关于良好食品安全与个人卫生做法的建议》（致食品业者通告），2024 年 12 月 6 日。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (PDF). 'Thaw frozen food in a chiller maintained at a temperature between 0 to 4°C'. Used for 'a fridge is about 4 °C or colder'; it is advice to food businesses, not a measurement of home fridges.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（PDF）。冷冻食品要放在保持 0–4 °C 的冷藏柜里解冻。用于“冰箱约 4 °C 或更低”；这是给食品业者的建议，不是家用冰箱的测量。

text.en: Animal Diversity Web (University of Michigan Museum of Zoology): Eonycteris spelaea, lesser dawn bat.
text.zh: 动物多样性网（密歇根大学动物学博物馆）：Eonycteris spelaea（洞穴花蜜蝠）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Length '85 to 125 mm'; forearm 60–85 mm. The cave nectar bat's size; NParks's page has none.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。体长 85–125 毫米；前臂 60–85 毫米。洞穴花蜜蝠的尺寸；NParks 的页面没有。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Ornate sunbird.
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Ornate sunbird。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. 'The ornate sunbird is 10–11.4 cm (3.9–4.5 in) in length.' A tertiary source: NParks gives no size, and the bird handbook pages refused access. Used only for the model's size.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。这种太阳鸟长 10–11.4 厘米。这是三手资料：NParks 没有给尺寸，鸟类手册的页面拒绝访问。只用于模型的大小。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Germination.
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Germination（萌发）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 (section on dicot germination). 'The part of the plant that first emerges from the seed is the embryonic root'. OpenStax 32.2 says the same only for a grass seed; the University of Minnesota open textbook uses the root's emergence as the measure of germination in beans.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取（双子叶植物萌发一节）。最先从种子长出来的是胚根。OpenStax 32.2 只就禾草种子说了同样的话；明尼苏达大学的开放教材把胚根长出作为豆类萌发的标准。

text.en: Ghasemlou, M. et al. (2010). Study on postharvest physico-mechanical and aerodynamic properties of mungbean seeds. International Journal of Food Engineering 6(6). doi:10.2202/1556-3758.1786.
text.zh: Ghasemlou, M. 等（2010）《绿豆种子收获后的物理力学与空气动力学特性研究》，《国际食品工程杂志》6(6)，doi:10.2202/1556-3758.1786。

note.en: Abstract read 2026-10-21 as the AGRIS record through the fetch tool's extraction (not string-checked): 'Length: 4.32 to 5.10 mm' over the moisture contents tested. The only seed size found; NParks gives none.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 通过抓取工具读到 AGRIS 记录里的摘要（没有逐字核对）：在所测的含水量范围内，长 4.32–5.10 毫米。这是唯一找到的种子尺寸；NParks 没有给。

text.en: Wikipedia (Chinese): 苔藓植物 (bryophytes).
text.zh: 中文维基百科：苔藓植物。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 through the fetch tool (traditional characters). The lead says they have no flowers, make no seeds and reproduce by spores ('也沒有花朵，不製造種子，而是經由孢子來繁殖'). Used for 苔藓 and for 'no flowers, no seeds'.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 通过抓取工具读取（原文繁体）。导言说苔藓植物没有花，不产生种子，靠孢子繁殖。用于“苔藓”这个词和“不开花、不结种子”。

text.en: Paper on fig wasps in 生物多样性 (Biodiversity Science) 17(2): 168–173, 2009.

note.en: Read 2026-10-21 through the fetch tool's extraction only. It uses 传粉榕小蜂 (pollinating fig wasp): the source for the Chinese name 榕小蜂. Not used for any fact about fig wasps.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 只读到抓取工具的提取文本。文中用“传粉榕小蜂”：这是中文名“榕小蜂”的来源。不用于榕小蜂的任何事实。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Apis cerana cerana (Asiatic honey bee).
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Apis cerana cerana（东方蜜蜂）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Workers '10–13 mm'. A tertiary source, used only to check that the model's bee is honeybee-sized; it does not say which bees visit chillies in Singapore.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。工蜂长 10–13 毫米。这是三手资料，只用来核对模型里的蜜蜂和真蜜蜂差不多大；它没有说新加坡访辣椒花的是哪一种蜂。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Moss.
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Moss（苔藓）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Mosses 'are typically 0.2–10 cm' tall. No size was found for a particular moss in Singapore, so the model's moss has no scale bar.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。苔藓一般高 0.2–10 厘米。没有找到新加坡某一种苔藓的尺寸，所以模型里的苔藓没有比例尺。

text.en: Wikipedia (English): Etiolation.
text.zh: 英文维基百科：Etiolation（黄化）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. Plants grown in the dark have a 'pale yellow color'. A general statement, not about mung beans; S66 is the mung-bean evidence. Supports the Chinese 淡黄 / 发白 for cup D.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。在暗处长的植物呈淡黄色。这是一般性的说法，不专指绿豆；绿豆的证据是 S66。用于 D 杯幼苗的“淡黄 / 发白”。

text.en: Save My Exams, 'Practical: Conditions for Germination' (Edexcel IGCSE Biology revision notes).
text.zh: Save My Exams《实验：萌发的条件》（Edexcel IGCSE 生物复习笔记）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-21. A secondary revision site: a tube of seeds is covered with water and 'a layer of oil on top' to test the need for oxygen. Used only in the chapter 07 More box on why the model has no cup under water.
note.zh: 2026-10-21 读取。中学复习网站：把种子泡在水里，水面加一层油，用来测试种子是否需要氧。只用在第 07 章细看“为什么没有泡水的杯子”。
